oneLine: Every New Yorker gets a portrait. Even the villains.
oneBreath: The city has been watching you your whole life. It turns out it was taking notes, and the notes are beautiful.
thesis: Every piece in this collection is about one thing: what it means to be seen in a city of eight million.
networked: NEW YORKERS is a networked digital art collection. No piece stands alone: characters return across eras, love stories span five hundred numbers, villains earn their redemptions, and every hour, month, moon and subway line has a portrait that belongs to somebody. The connections are the collection.

marks.name: The Eye Flower
marks.meaning: The city's attention. It blooms wherever a moment is truly witnessed. Its iris is human because the city's eyes are its people.

marks.name: The Blue Evil Eye
marks.meaning: Protection. It watches so you can stop watching your back. It never moves, never blinks in stills. It is MLow's sovereign mark.

marks.name: The Circle Grid Flower Sigil
marks.meaning: Community. The Blossom mark. It appears where people have built something together. The Sigil Writer paints them at 4am and has never been seen.

eras.title: The Originals
eras.desc: The founding census. Legends, neighbors, places, villains. The city assembled its cast.

eras.title: The Eye Flower Era
eras.desc: The flowers arrive. The city starts visibly watching. Myth enters the frame: the Rat King is crowned, the Trash Mountain rises.

eras.title: The City Expands
eras.desc: The heroes and lost trades. The city remembers who built it and who keeps it alive at 4am.

eras.title: The Brand Batch
eras.desc: Protection and community arrive as symbols. The evil eye starts watching from every frame. Number 1000, The Subway Samaritan, states the whole thesis: strangers save strangers here.

eras.title: The Masterworks
eras.desc: Every character gets its own color story and its own decisive moment. The collection learns chiaroscuro and grief and joy: the Oath Ceremony, the Orange Sky, the Angel of the Waters.

eras.title: The Mythos
eras.desc: The origin stories, the illusions, the hidden city. The world explains itself. Love arcs pay off. The Rat King marries the Pigeon Queen and the kingdoms of above and below unite.

eras.title: The Deep City
eras.desc: The collection swallows the calendar and the clock: the Hours, the Months, the Moons, the Decades, the Lines, the Tarot. History enters: the Boatlift, the Miracle on the Hudson. The chapter closes with the Curtain Call, and then refuses to close.

lineage: Seven eras, one bloodline. The Originals built the cast. The Eye Flowers taught the city to watch. The Working City remembered its hands. The Marks made protection visible. The Masterworks gave every face a feeling. The Mythos explained the world. The Deep City swallowed time itself. Each era descends from the one before it, and the characters carry the inheritance forward.

spine.title: The Seed Beneath the City
spine.text: Before everything, one glowing seed sleeps below the tunnels. Its roots thread the subway lines. The city grows on top of it and has always felt slightly alive because of it.

spine.title: The First Eye Flower
spine.text: A century ago, a dreamer's tear fell through a subway grate. The seed answered. One impossible flower grew where it landed and looked back at the city.

spine.title: The Gardener of the First Bloom
spine.text: Somebody watered that grate every night in 1926 and told no one. Devotion is the collection's oldest job.

spine.title: The Spread
spine.text: Bees carry iris pollen along the elevated lines. Blooms open when headlights pass. The flower district learns to harvest them. The library saves the seeds. Kids trade them like marbles.

spine.title: The Protection Economy
spine.text: The Talisman Maker births every evil eye in the city from molten blue glass. The factory hangs them like a protective galaxy. The basket dog delivers them.

spine.title: The Alignment
spine.text: One night each May, every eye flower in the city opens at once and looks up. The calendar and the mythos agree.

spine.title: The Revelation
spine.text: The map room's secret drawer opens: every bloom in the city plotted forms one enormous iris around the first grate. The city is not covered in eyes. The city IS an eye.

spine.title: The Continuation
spine.text: The painter touches a blank canvas and a bud pushes up through the wet primer from inside the painting. The collection cannot end, because the city keeps making New Yorkers.

threads.name: The Love Thread
threads.desc: Love in this collection is a route map. A stranger across the platform becomes a poster, a reply, a proposal on the same fire escape, the same booth fifty years later.

threads.name: The Watcher Lineage
threads.desc: The Window Watcher sees everything. The watched become the watchers. The final watcher is the person holding the token.

threads.name: The Court of Two Kingdoms
threads.desc: The comedy engine. Above and below, reconciled by marriage and a shared bagel.

threads.name: The Kindness Files
threads.desc: The proof thread. When someone asks what the collection believes, point here.

threads.name: The Memory Thread
threads.desc: Loss, held gently. The city loses things and refuses to lose their meaning.

threads.name: The Villain Redemptions
threads.desc: Villains here are weather: survived, joked about, occasionally forgiven.

threads.name: The Succession Thread
threads.desc: The city renews itself. Nothing ends; it gets handed down.

sets.name: The Hours
sets.hook: Own your hour. Everyone has one that belongs to them.

sets.name: The Months
sets.hook: Own your month. Everyone has a birthday.

sets.name: The Moons
sets.hook: Twelve full moons over the city, named the old way.

sets.name: The Seasons
sets.hook: Four New York seasons, none of them subtle.

sets.name: The Elements
sets.hook: Steam, steel, glass, brick. The city's periodic table.

sets.name: The Decades
sets.hook: The Gilded Dusk to the Twenty Twenties. Time as a neighbor.

sets.name: The Never Built City
sets.hook: The highways, domes and runways the city talked itself out of.

sets.name: The Lost Buildings
sets.hook: Dreamland, the Singer Tower, the Crystal Palace. Gone, not forgotten.

sets.name: The Subway Lines
sets.hook: Own your line. Everyone has a home line.

sets.name: The New York Tarot
sets.hook: Twenty two cards. The Fool gets on at the airport.

living.note: The archive holds 88 living loops and 61 films of the characters. The animation library is the collection breathing.

drop.headline: Released in named editions. THE MARKS on SuperRare and Transient Labs, then THE CENSUS RELEASE on OpenSea about two weeks later. Dates not signed.
drop.body: The collection mints as dynamic tokens on Transient Labs ERC-7160 with OpenSea. The artist appends chapters, the collector pins the state they love. Chapters are eras. The sets are quests. The milestones are the grails. The story is the mechanic. NEW YORKERS is sold in named releases. Each release is sized and closed before it opens. Nothing is added to a release once it closes, and no New Yorker is ever sold twice. The census is still being painted, so more releases will follow, and every one is announced in advance, the same way.
drop.census: The census is numbered to 2266 and counting. Not every number is painted yet. That is the point.

artist.bio: MLow is a New York based multidisciplinary artist who combines photography, AI, GANs and 3D art to make vibrant digital landscapes and surreal portraits. He holds a degree in Arts and Science from NYU and a Master's from NYU Wagner, and his work explores where technology meets human experience. It has been recognised in the crypto art world, including a win in the AI category of Optimism's We Love The Art competition and features in digital art spaces including Beeple Studios. His podcast, the MLow Show, has hosted more than 50 of the top crypto art collectors and artists. His art has run on more than 5,000 New York City taxis on five separate occasions and has been shown on the streets of 10 major cities across 10 countries. Through the work he invites viewers to question reality and imagine alternative worlds, turning data and code into something that lands on a human level. The art is a bridge between technology and spirituality, a visual language for the digital age that speaks to our deepest experiences and aspirations.
artist.angle: The eye flowers in this art are the fLOWers. They came out of surviving cancer. The artist drew a city of eight million people while getting through the thing that nearly took him out of it. Chai Lifeline, the drop's charity partner, supported him through it.
artist.short: MLow is a New York based multidisciplinary artist working in photography, AI, GANs and 3D. NYU Arts and Science, NYU Wagner. His work has run on more than 5,000 New York City taxis and been shown on the streets of 10 cities across 10 countries.

Heroes.name: Ticker Tape
Heroes.blurb: The parade down the Canyon of Heroes. Champions, first responders, the beloved.

Villains.name: The Machine
Villains.blurb: Tammany and everything after it. Landlords, power brokers, the ones you survive.

Hustlers.name: Corner Hustle
Hustlers.blurb: Vendors, rappers, grinders. Anybody working an angle on a corner.

Strays.name: Alley Cats
Strays.blurb: The feral city. Animals, creatures, the ones nobody keeps.

Underground.name: Third Rail
Underground.blurb: The subway, the punks, the noir, the occult. The live wire you do not touch.

Stoop.name: Front Steps
Stoop.blurb: Old New York on the stoop. Elders, sitters, watchers, the block that never left.

Builders.name: Hard Hats
Builders.blurb: The ones who raised it. Makers, inventors, infrastructure, ironworkers.

Degens.name: After Hours
Degens.blurb: Rooftops, back rooms and the crypto crowd. The city after midnight.

Transplants.name: Two Suitcases
Transplants.blurb: Off the bus with a dream and everything they own in two hands.

Citizens.name: Eight Million
Citizens.blurb: Eight million main characters. The ordinary people who are the whole point.

Places.name: The Blocks
Places.blurb: Named ground. Corners, landmarks, neighbourhoods, the places themselves.

Design.name: Made Here
Design.blurb: The made things. Architecture, objects, signage, food, the built city.

Process.name: Open Notebook
Process.blurb: The work about the work. Shown rather than hidden.
